items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He and I made a record together.

ctx.x: He’s outrageous, like an overgrown schoolboy, some of the things he would do. Fly into rages. He would do things that were really crude, but yet he was a wonderful player. He and I made a record together.
I was going to say you have a recording. Joe Venuti is one of the great jazz violinists. How about this for a twist: Leonard Bernstein.
